title: Sources: Chinese companies like Moonshot are reconsidering "red-chip structures", which make it easier to list overseas, after China blocked the Meta-Manus deal (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Chinese companies like Moonshot are reconsidering “red-chip structures”, which make it easier to list overseas, after China blocked the Meta-Manus deal — Beijing's tighter scrutiny of foreign capital forces groups to rethink ownership structures behind listings boom
